comment: Whether guests, not only signed-in customers, can use Email to a Friend.
modal: When **Yes**, visitors who are not signed in can send the **Email to a Friend** product share. Applies only when the feature is enabled. Can be set per website or store view.

comment: The maximum number of recipients allowed per Email to a Friend message.
modal: The maximum number of recipient addresses allowed in a single Email to a Friend message. Applies only when the feature is enabled. Can be set per website or store view.

comment: The maximum number of products a sender can share by email within one hour.
modal: Rate limit for how many products a single sender may share via Email to a Friend within one hour. Applies only when the feature is enabled. Can be set per website or store view.

comment: How senders are identified when enforcing the Email to a Friend sending limits.
modal: Selects the method used to identify a sender when applying the sending limits. Applies only when the feature is enabled. Can be set per website or store view.
